scope: Explicitly reviewed four-request continuation after local proxy-invocation defect; original failed request, zero measured bytes and full uncertain reservation preserved; no automatic retries

selection.universe: All rows on independent current PumpSwap DEX pages 1–4, sorted by documented h24_volume_usd_desc. Not a historical or exhaustive census.
selection.leadRule: Valid public addresses; canonical PumpSwap SOL-quoted PDA address consistency; index-created age >=0 and <=6h at that page receipt. Index time remains UNVERIFIED, not an on-chain migration proof or current support validation.
selection.activityFilter: NONE: retain every qualifying lead, including zero-activity and weak controls.
selection.outcomeSelection: NONE: population frozen at completion, before any later outcome retrieval.

terms.claim: Public keyless API documented 10 calls/min; own >=12s physical start spacing. Documentation is historical cached evidence; actual responses determine this test.
